title: Shelf Density and Overflow Risk
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), intake scans (`collection:scan`), market prices (`collection:price`), item photos (`collection:photo`), authentication records (`collection:auth`), loans (`collection:loan`), and condition audits (`collection:condition`).
app: Collection telemetry from personal catalogues, NFC scans, pricing feeds, authentication records, loan logs, shelf measurements, and item-condition audits streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=collection:item
| stats sum(width_cm) as used_width_cm latest(shelf_width_cm) as shelf_width_cm by shelf
| eval load_pct=round(100*used_width_cm/shelf_width_cm,1)
| sort - load_pct
description: Calculates how full each shelf is so space pressure and overflow risk show up before reorganization becomes urgent.
value: Collectors run out of display or storage space gradually, and shelf density is a simple metric that makes the squeeze visible.
implementation: Maintain width estimates or measured dimensions for items and track the physical width of each shelf or drawer.
visualization: Bar chart of shelf load percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It logs which shelves are getting so full that they are close to overflowing.
